$comment: Registry of every `allow-raw` exemption in the codebase. An inline `// allow-raw: <id>` comment is only accepted by scripts/lint-raw-values.ts if a matching entry exists here for the same file. Run `npm run tokens:lint-values` after any change.

exemptions.reason: h-[calc(100%-1px)] — the active tab must overlap the 1px bottom border of the tab list. A subpixel offset derived from a border width has no equivalent in the spacing scale.
#ccc and #fff are values matched inside CSS attribute selectors ([stroke='#ccc']) against SVG attributes injected by Recharts at runtime. A custom property cannot appear inside an attribute selector.
z-1 raises the indicator above the menu bar border inside a local stacking context. The z-index scale addresses global layers (dropdown, modal, tooltip), not local ordering.
top-[60%] positions the arrow diamond relative to the indicator bar. A geometric ratio, not a spacing decision.
max-h-[80vh] caps the drawer height relative to the viewport. Viewport units are outside the spacing scale by design.
The translate-y calc compensates for the rotation of the arrow square so its tip lands exactly on the edge. Derived from the geometry, not from the spacing scale.
translate-x calc(100%-2px) compensates for the border inset of the thumb so it stops flush with the track edge.
z-0 creates a local stacking context so the range-highlight pseudo-elements paint below the day cells. Two occurrences, same rationale.
Canvas and CanvasText are CSS system color keywords. Native <option> and <optgroup> are rendered by the OS, which ignores custom properties. Two occurrences, same rationale.
The +2px in the collapsed icon width compensates for the border of the floating variant, so the rail lines up with the expanded sidebar.

w-[calc(var(--sidebar-width-icon)+(--spacing(4)))] — the floating and inset variants sit inside a padded shell, so the collapsed rail measures its own width plus that padding. The sum is a property of the variant, not a value of the spacing scale.

left/right-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)] — the offcanvas panel is pushed out by exactly its own width, mirrored per side. The multiplication by -1 is the mirroring itself, and a token cannot carry a sign.

max-w-[calc(100%-var(--space-component-lg))] — the dialog is capped at the viewport minus one gutter on each side. The gutter is already a token; the subtraction from a width the component does not know cannot be one.

min-w-[calc(var(--anchor-width)+--spacing(7))] — --anchor-width is measured by Base UI when the popup opens. The popup must clear the trigger plus room for the clear and chevron buttons; only that room is a token.

max-h-[min(calc(--spacing(72)---spacing(9)),calc(var(--available-height)---spacing(9)))] — the list stops at the shorter of a fixed ceiling and the space Base UI measured below the trigger, both less the sticky input. The comparison is the behaviour, not a size.
